acceptable_paraphrases: A rectangle has A, B and C properties
The properties of a rectangle include A, B, C
Properties A, B, and C apply to rectangles
misconceptions: believing that only one or two properties are true for all rectangles
stating that these are not properties of a rectangle
mixing up the property names (e.g., treating A and B as interchangeable)
grading_notes: Credit will be given for including all required concepts. Optional concepts, if present, will earn bonus points. Misstatements or confusion about the properties will result in deductions.
